identity_notes: L-tyrosine is a genuinely well-studied cognitive/stress-performance nootropic (24 kept of 160 screened), distinct from the large PKU/tyrosine-as-adjunct-therapy literature (10796799, 23737086, 33427303 -- a Cochrane-style review series specifically about tyrosine supplementation as an ADJUNCT to phenylalanine-RESTRICTED diets in PKU patients, kept but flagged as a distinct, disease-specific population/rationale, not general supplementation). This retrieval was also heavily contaminated by three unrelated meanings/contexts of 'tyrosine': (1) tyrosine as a vaccine/immunotherapy ADSORPTION CARRIER (allergy vaccines, allergoids), rejected different_substance; (2) tyrosine kinase / tyrosinase enzyme literature (cancer receptor kinases, skin-whitening tyrosinase inhibitors, JAK inhibitors) -- a completely different biological meaning, rejected off_topic; and (3) PET radiotracers (11C- or 18F-labeled tyrosine analogs) used for tumor imaging, an injected diagnostic use unrelated to oral supplementation, rejected not_this_route. Acute tyrosine/phenylalanine DEPLETION paradigm studies (which remove rather than supplement tyrosine) were rejected not_intervention. Most retrieved abstracts for the genuine supplementation trials were truncated before the results sentence in this scope. Clear results that did survive: a creativity/deep-thinking claim (25257259) is actually a NULL finding on close reading ('We found no evidence for an[y effect]') despite an affirmative-sounding title -- do not cite this as positive evidence; a dedicated dose-ranging heat-exercise trial (31834099) found NO influence of low/medium/high-dose tyrosine on exercise performance; a narcolepsy trial (2572797) found only 3 of 28 mood/arousal measures improved, with core narcolepsy symptoms unaffected in the captured text; and fear-expression suppression (31690824) and heat-induced cognitive-decline attenuation (24141022) both appear genuinely positive from the captured excerpts. Several kept trials combine tyrosine with caffeine/theanine (31771598, 38975711) or deliver it within a protein-rich drink (10230711), so isolated tyrosine's contribution cannot be determined from those records.
